title: Faster to the Wrong Answer: The Price of Local Updates in Federated Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.24057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local computation can improve the conditioning of federated updates but may also introduce bias, causing their fixed point to differ from the global minimizer. We characterize the minimum worst-case bias achievable under a prescribed conditioning bound. We consider strongly convex quadratic client objectives with Hessian eigenvalues in $[\mu,L]$ and local updates represented by a shared positive spectral filter. Client heterogeneity is measured by the root-mean-square gradient at the global minimizer. For a uniform surrogate condition number bounded by $\chi\in[1,L/\mu]$, we establish the exact worst-case bias per unit heterogeneity, $(L-\mu\chi)/(2\mu L\sqrt{\chi})$, and show that local gradient descent with sufficiently small step sizes and proximal updates attain this bound. translated_title: 更快地得到错误答案：联邦优化中局部更新的代价
translated_abstract: 局部计算可以改善联邦更新的条件数，但也可能引入偏差，导致其不动点偏离全局最小值点。我们刻画了在给定条件数约束下可达到的最小最坏情况偏差。我们考虑了Hessian特征值位于区间[μ,L]内的强凸二次型客户端目标函数，并将局部更新表示为共享的正谱滤波器。客户端异质性通过全局最小值点处的均方根梯度来度量。对于由χ∈[1,L/μ]界定的统一代理条件数，我们建立了单位异质性下的精确最坏情况偏差 (L−μχ)/(2μL√χ)，并证明步长足够小的局部梯度下降和近端更新可以达到该界。我们的分析将任意维度的客户端群体（包括Hessian矩阵不可交换的情形）归约为标量曲率上的分布。这一归约提供了最优……
tldr: 该论文刻画了联邦学习中在给定条件数约束下局部更新可达到的精确最坏情况偏差，揭示了局部计算加速与更新偏差之间的根本权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the exact worst-case bias of local updates in federated learning under a prescribed conditioning bound, revealing the fundamental trade-off between the speedup of local computation and the bias it introduces.
